# CSR Word Reference Template

## Purpose

This directory contains the Word reference document used by `/export-views` when converting Markdown views to `.docx` format.

The reference document controls heading styles, font, margins, header/footer, and paragraph spacing in all exported Word views.

## Expected File

```text
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/templates/word/csr_view_reference.docx
```

## Status

**This file must be created manually.** It is a binary `.docx` file that cannot be generated by CSR.

## How to Create It

### Option A — Generate from Pandoc default (quickest)

With Pandoc installed, run in the repository root:

```bash
pandoc --print-default-data-file reference.docx > ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/templates/word/csr_view_reference.docx
```

Then open `csr_view_reference.docx` in Word, adjust the following styles, and save:

- **Heading 1** — section title
- **Heading 2** — subsection title
- **Heading 3** — sub-subsection
- **Normal** — body text
- **Table** — table style
- **Code** / `Verbatim Char` — inline code and code blocks

### Option B — Start from an existing corporate template

Copy your organisation's Word template to this directory and rename it `csr_view_reference.docx`. Verify it defines at minimum: Heading 1, Heading 2, Normal, and a Table style.

## Fallback Behavior

If `csr_view_reference.docx` is absent, `/export-views` uses Pandoc's built-in default Word styles and emits:

```text
WARNING: ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/templates/word/csr_view_reference.docx not found — using Pandoc defaults
```

The export proceeds normally; only the visual formatting differs.
